description: Canonical de-duplicated V3 capability map. Every DSS core module and DSS extension has exactly one owning capability. Gate0, Enhancement and REC vocabularies are references/roll-ups/milestones only and never create a second functional owner.

capabilities.name: Rules, Legality & Hard Constraints
capabilities.boundary: Rules and hard legality are authoritative here; final GO governance consumes them but does not re-own them.

capabilities.name: Official Native Authority & Identity
capabilities.boundary: Official FPL remains the one native truth owner; REC items harden access/reconciliation only.

capabilities.name: Phase/Squad Authority, Team Value & Sell Arithmetic
capabilities.boundary: Manual/phase authority governs the canonical squad state; optimizer and report layers consume it.

capabilities.name: Availability, Injury & Suspension
capabilities.boundary: Official availability is native; verified news is enrichment evidence rather than a second status authority.

capabilities.name: Starter Security, xMins, Substitution & DNP
capabilities.boundary: All minutes-risk signals feed one xMins distribution; downstream guardrails must not apply a second minutes penalty.

capabilities.name: Tactical Role Evidence
capabilities.boundary: REC-41 enriches the existing DSS-07 player-feature contract; it is not a parallel tactical engine.

capabilities.name: System / Formation Fit Evidence
capabilities.boundary: System evidence shares player_features plumbing but remains a distinct evidence dimension from tactical role.

capabilities.name: Positional Competition & Rotation
capabilities.boundary: Competition/rotation is an input to xMins, not a second independent DNP penalty.

capabilities.name: Set-Piece Hierarchy
capabilities.boundary: One normalized set-piece hierarchy feeds projection and reporting.

capabilities.name: Penalty Hierarchy & Succession
capabilities.boundary: Penalty evidence is a specialized role signal consumed by the one projection engine.

capabilities.name: Attacking Underlying Rates & Sustainability
capabilities.boundary: Current attacking evidence and small-sample protection are one robust-rate pipeline.

capabilities.name: DefCon, Bonus & Clean-Sheet Scoring Routes
capabilities.boundary: Rules define scoring; prediction owns probabilistic scoring-route evaluation.

capabilities.name: Team Attacking/Defensive Strength
capabilities.boundary: A single team-strength model supplies all fixture projections.

capabilities.name: Fixture Context, Difficulty & Swing
capabilities.boundary: Fixture context is shared input to projection; rest/recovery is owned by schedule-load capability.

capabilities.name: Multi-Horizon 3/5/10/15GW Strategy
capabilities.boundary: ENH-04 is a roll-up of one multi-horizon projection/optimization capability.

capabilities.name: European, Domestic Cup & International Schedule Load
capabilities.boundary: All congestion/travel/recovery evidence enters one bounded schedule-load contract feeding xMins.

capabilities.name: Preseason, Last-Season, Historical & Current Priors
capabilities.boundary: Prior construction owns baseline evidence; projection owns regression against it.

capabilities.name: Price Value & Budget Opportunity Cost
capabilities.boundary: Value/opportunity cost belongs to package utility; price-movement risk is CAP-19.

capabilities.name: Ownership, EO, Transfer Momentum & Price Movement
capabilities.boundary: Market-state facts feed one price intelligence/reconciliation pipeline.

capabilities.name: Prediction Calibration, Confidence, Drift & Actionability
capabilities.boundary: Calibration, uncertainty and actionability are maturity stages of one evaluation stack.

capabilities.name: Package & Structural Optimizer
capabilities.boundary: All transfer guardrails modify one package objective; they are not separate transfer engines.

capabilities.name: Lineup, Formation, Bench & Autosub
capabilities.boundary: Lineup robustness is governance around one legal XI/bench selection.

capabilities.name: Captaincy & Vice-Captaincy
capabilities.boundary: Captain selection, safe pool and DNP guard are one captaincy capability.

capabilities.name: Chip, Blank & Double Strategic Context
capabilities.boundary: Chip legality/state is owned here; BGW/DGW strategy must not be inferred from legality alone.

capabilities.name: Point-in-Time Integrity & Leakage Safety
capabilities.boundary: ENH-02 is a roll-up of one leakage-safety capability.

capabilities.name: Source Reliability, Fusion & Challenger Scorecard
capabilities.boundary: Reachability, freshness, evidence fusion and source health are one source domain; challenger scoring consumes it.

capabilities.name: Full-DSS Watchlist & Lifecycle
capabilities.boundary: Watchlist is a product consuming canonical capabilities; it does not re-own every DSS signal it screens.

capabilities.name: Decision-First Reporting & Checkpoint Completeness
capabilities.boundary: Reporting owns decision narrative/checkpoint construction; serving materialization consumes that draft.

capabilities.name: Personal GW Actual/Projection & Human Decision Authority
capabilities.boundary: Personal timeline/override is a serving view over canonical team/lineup truth, not another lineup or chip engine.

capabilities.name: Mini-League Tracking & Strategy
capabilities.boundary: Tracking is current evidence; attack/protect strategy remains conditional and must not duplicate ownership/EO or captaincy logic.
